jobs.title: Intern [GIP] - Product Management & Product Design
jobs.text:
Job Description
Grab Internship Program Overview: 
 The Grab Internship Program offers students and recent graduates the opportunity to work alongside teams driving Southeast Asia's leading everyday superapp. As an intern, you will not just observe—you will actively contribute to real business challenges, partner with cross-functional teams, and gain hands-on experience in how large-scale, tech-enabled operations run. Throughout the program, you will receive mentorship, project ownership, and exposure to Grab's culture of problem-solving and social impact.
 Be a part of an exciting internship from Jan - June 2027. Please note that the work placement for this position is based at our South Jakarta office.
 Get to Know the Role 
 In this role, you will leverage data and metrics to drive product improvements and foster cross-functional collaboration toward delivering impactful solutions. You will partner closely with diverse teams across Engineering (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, QA), Product Design, and Product Development to build and enhance our technology.
 The Critical Tasks You Will Perform 
 User & Market Discovery: Conduct user research, competitor teardowns, and data analyses to uncover pain points and evaluate product opportunities.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Software Engineers, QA, and Business Operations throughout sprint cycles to ensure seamless delivery and implementation.
 Experimentation & Iteration: Assist in tracking post-launch feature adoption, user feedback, and funnel metrics to drive continuous iterations.
 For Product Management Track: 
 Draft structured Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user stories with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.
 Work with analytics to analyze funnels, define business logic, and prioritize feature backlogs.
 Prepare product briefs, roadmap updates, and release notes for cross-functional stakeholders.
 For Product Design Track: 
 Map user flows and design wireframes, high-fidelity UI screens, and interactive clickable prototypes in Figma.
 Apply and contribute to Grab's design system, ensuring visual consistency, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive layout standards.
 Plan and support usability testing sessions, synthesize qualitative feedback, and prepare design specs for engineering handoff.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need 
 Minimum GPA of 3.25/4.00
 Final-year student or fresh graduate with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Visual Communication Design (DKV), Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field.
 Demonstrated structured problem-solving, product intuition, and familiarity with data interpretation / spreadsheet modeling.
 Proficiency in Figma (components, auto-layout, prototyping).
 Strong proficiency in Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel; familiarity with Jira/Confluence is a plus.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia; ability to articulate concepts clearly.
 High curiosity, adaptability to fast-paced agile environments, and commitment to a full-time onsite internship
Additional Information
Life at Grab 
 We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer our Interns:
 Comprehensive training and personal development programs: You will develop your soft skills and hard skills curated for you
 Mentoring by the Grab Leaders: You will be accompanied by a team of experienced leaders during the internship program
 Government Medical benefit: We have you covered with 3 BPJAMSOSTEK programs
 Engagement and networking activities: You will participate in fun & interactive engagements that not only entertain but also provide valuable networking opportunities
 Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our Flex Work arrangements such as differentiated hours
